$Comment: One ice mace shock wave (2026-10-21): the vanilla Gobliterator club slam shockwave (Goblin_Gobliterator_Club_Slam_Shockwave_Selector): a Donut ring that grows from 0 to 50 blocks over 2.25 s (about 22 blocks/s), 2 wide and 2 high from 1 block under his feet, so a jump clears it. Centred where the mace head lands (~1.2 blocks in front of him; selector forward is -Z, particle forward is +Z, as in the vanilla file). Players get Root_AT_Ice_King_Ice_Mace_Wave_Damage (HitEntityRules Player); every other mob Root_AT_Ice_King_Ice_Mace_Wave_Mob_Damage, which skips his ice creatures (AT_Ice_King_Ice_Body) so they are not launched (2026-10-21: hit every mob, as the ultimate). Particle: AT_Ice_King_Mace_Slam, the ice copy of the vanilla Gobliterator_Slam (only colours changed, so its ring grows exactly with this Donut). Started as a fork (Parallel) by AT_Ice_King_Ice_Mace_Slam, so several waves run at once. 2026-10-22 sounds (SFX_AT_Ice_King_* events, rule: each sound on its exact moment): Mace_Impact at each impact (ON TRIAL; the charge and wave stay as they were). Fallback if it does not convince: put back SFX_Gobliterator_Club_Slam_Impact, the old sound, kept on purpose.
